First, we calculate $P(B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\ 0.9 & =0.35+P(B)-0.15 \\ P(B) & =0.9+0.15-0.35 \\  & =0.7\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P({B}^{′}) & =1-P(B) \\  & =1-0.7 \\  & =0.3.\end{aligned}
$$
